visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with grainy, black-and-white security camera footage of a man in a dark navy hoodie pointing a firearm towards the right. A large red arrow graphic points at his face. Overlaid at the top is a yellow and red title with stylized Chinese characters. (2) A transition to a simple line-art animation on a black background shows a red outlined bank building with orange flames. Two stick figures with smiling faces run away from the building carrying bags with dollar signs. The date '1995年1月6日' is displayed in white text at the bottom. (3) The camera returns to the grainy security footage. The man in the hoodie looks directly into the lens and smiles broadly, showing his teeth. He is not wearing a mask or any facial covering. A red devil face emoji appears briefly beside his head. (4) An animation shows a police dog in uniform leading a group of handcuffed cartoon animals, including a bear, a rabbit, and a cat, towards a police car. (5) The security footage reappears with speech bubbles saying '我有塗檸檬汁!' (I have lemon juice applied). A cartoon lemon graphic is visible. A digital effect makes the man's lower body appear to vanish in fire before he becomes semi-transparent. (6) A young man with dark hair, wearing a grey t-shirt, appears against a solid dark grey background. He speaks directly to the camera, gesturing with his right hand and holding a sheet of paper. (7) A low-resolution home video shows a toddler in a diaper in a living room. The baby lifts a toy barbell over its head, wobbling slightly before dropping it. The setting includes a rug, a sofa, and bright natural lighting from a window.
